نندلع (form VII)
# نَنْدَلِعُ (nandaliʕu) /nan.da.li.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْدَلَعَ (indalaʕa)
# نَنْدَلِعَ (nandaliʕa) /nan.da.li.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْدَلَعَ (indalaʕa)
# نَنْدَلِعْ (nandaliʕ) /nan.da.liʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْدَلَعَ (indalaʕa)
